Crux AI is a Palo Alto, California company in the AI infrastructure sector; the Crunchbase description says it provides integrated AI services. Crunchbase shows very large total funding of about $27 billion, with the latest round dated September 2026, which would place it among the most heavily funded private AI infrastructure businesses. Customers and revenue model are not clear from the data available, though they are likely enterprise and AI developers. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

DayOne is a Singapore-headquartered developer and operator of hyperscale data centers and AI infrastructure, serving cloud providers and large internet companies with leased capacity across Asia, with campuses in markets such as Malaysia (Johor), Indonesia, Thailand and China. Originally spun out of China's GDS International. It has raised about $14.5 billion in total funding, latest in October 2026. B2B infrastructure with little consumer brand awareness.

Digital Realty is a data center REIT that leases colocation, interconnection and hyperscale space to cloud providers, enterprises and network operators, with several hundred facilities across about 25 countries and key platforms such as PlatformDIGITAL and Interxion. Revenue comes from long-term leases. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, and listed on the NYSE (DLR), with a market value well above $50 billion. B2B infrastructure brand, little consumer awareness, but active in corporate sponsorship at times.

Firmus Technologies is an Australian company building AI data centers it calls AI Factories, using liquid-cooled infrastructure to host GPU compute for AI developers and enterprises, with its Project Southgate and Tasmanian sites linked to Nvidia-based capacity. Crunchbase lists headquarters in Saint Leonards, Tasmania, and about $13.1 billion in total funding, latest dated August 2026. Private B2B infrastructure business with limited public brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Mesabi Metallics, based in Nashwauk, Minnesota, is developing a large iron ore mine and pellet plant on Minnesota's Iron Range, formerly the Essar Steel Minnesota project, to supply iron ore pellets to steelmakers. Customers are steel producers and revenue depends on completing and ramping the project, which has had long delays and financing disputes. Crunchbase shows about $11.4 billion in funding, latest in September 2026. Privately held B2B commodity business with no consumer brand.

Northvolt was a Swedish lithium-ion battery maker founded in 2016 in Stockholm by former Tesla executives, building cells for electric vehicles and energy storage at its Skelleftea gigafactory, with customers such as Volkswagen, BMW, Volvo and Scania. It raised well over $13 billion in debt and equity but filed for bankruptcy in Sweden in March 2025, and its assets were later bought by Lyten in 2025. Mostly B2B, but high profile in the European press.

Nscale is a London-based AI infrastructure company building AI data centers and operating GPU cloud services for AI developers and enterprises, with sites in Norway (Glomfjord), the UK and elsewhere, and partnerships with Nvidia and Microsoft. Spun out of Arkon Energy. Crunchbase shows about $13.3 billion in total funding, latest in September 2026. B2B infrastructure provider, young and fast-growing, with little consumer brand awareness.

NVIDIA designs GPUs, AI accelerators, networking and software platforms (CUDA, DGX, GeForce, Blackwell chips) that dominate AI training and data center computing, with further business in gaming, professional graphics and automotive. Customers include hyperscalers, enterprises, PC makers and gamers; revenue is chip and system sales. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, founded 1993, listed on Nasdaq (NVDA) and among the world's most valuable companies. Strong consumer brand via GeForce gaming and a frequent sponsor and partner of tech and sport.

Ovintiv is a North American independent oil and natural gas producer based in Denver, Colorado, with operations in the Permian, Montney and Anadarko basins, formed from the Encana redomicile in 2020, and it acquired Black Swan Energy assets in 2025. It sells crude, NGLs and gas to refiners and marketers. Listed on the NYSE and Toronto Stock Exchange (OVV). Large upstream producer but B2B, with little consumer brand visibility.

QXO is a building products distribution company based in Greenwich, Connecticut, led by Brad Jacobs and listed on the NYSE (QXO). It acquired Beacon Roofing Supply in 2025 to become a major distributor of roofing, siding and related materials to contractors in North America, and has pursued further acquisitions, aiming to build a very large distribution platform. Revenue comes from product distribution to professional contractors. B2B, with limited consumer awareness.

Realty Income is a San Diego-based real estate investment trust that owns thousands of single-tenant commercial properties, mainly net-lease retail, industrial and gaming assets, across the US and Europe, leased to tenants like convenience stores, drugstores and dollar stores. It earns rent and pays monthly dividends, marketing itself as The Monthly Dividend Company. Listed on the NYSE (O), with a market capitalisation of roughly $50 billion. Known to investors, not a consumer brand.

Snam is an Italian energy infrastructure company operating the country's natural gas transmission pipelines, storage and regasification terminals, and developing biomethane, hydrogen and carbon capture. Customers are gas shippers and utilities, paid regulated tariffs. Headquartered in San Donato Milanese near Milan, it was spun out of Eni in 2001 and is listed on Borsa Italiana (SRG). Large regulated B2B infrastructure business, a stakeholder in other European networks, with limited consumer brand visibility.

VICI Properties is a real estate investment trust specialising in gaming, hospitality and entertainment properties, spun out of Caesars Entertainment in 2017. It owns Caesars Palace Las Vegas, MGM Grand and the Venetian, leasing them on long triple-net leases to operators and also holding experiential assets such as Chelsea Piers. Listed on the NYSE (VICI) and headquartered in New York, although Crunchbase shows a Canadian location. Landlord to famous casinos, with indirect brand exposure but no direct consumer brand.

Welltower is a healthcare real estate investment trust owning senior housing communities, outpatient medical buildings and post-acute care properties across the US, Canada and the UK, leased to or operated by care providers. Revenue is rent and operating income from senior housing. Headquartered in Toledo, Ohio, and listed on the NYSE (WELL), with a market value well above $50 billion. Investor-oriented brand with low consumer awareness.

Abu Dhabi Ports Company, now operating as AD Ports Group, develops and runs ports, industrial zones, logistics, maritime services and digital trade platforms, including Khalifa Port and KEZAD. Customers are shipping lines, manufacturers and traders. Majority owned by the Abu Dhabi government through ADQ and listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADPORTS). Growing international presence in Africa, Asia and Europe. B2B and state-linked; active in sports and event sponsorship in the Gulf.

ACS (Actividades de Construccion y Servicios) is a Spanish construction and infrastructure group headquartered in Madrid, controlled by Florentino Perez, who is also president of Real Madrid. It owns Hochtief in Germany (with Turner and CIMIC), and Vias, and develops transport, energy and data center projects. Customers are governments and corporates; revenue is around 40 billion euros. Listed on the Madrid stock exchange (ACS). B2B, with limited consumer visibility.

Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone is India's largest private port operator, running Mundra and a network of ports and terminals plus logistics, rail and marine services, and some international terminals such as Haifa and Colombo. Customers are shipping lines, cargo owners and industrial groups. Part of the Adani Group, headquartered in Ahmedabad, and listed in India (NSE and BSE: ADANIPORTS). B2B infrastructure with strong brand recognition in India.

Agree Realty is a Royal Oak, Michigan real estate investment trust that acquires and develops net-leased retail properties occupied by high-quality tenants such as Walmart, Home Depot, Tractor Supply and Dollar General, with over 2,000 properties across the US. Revenue is rental income. Listed on the NYSE (ADC). Investor-facing company with no consumer brand.

Aldar Properties is Abu Dhabi's leading property developer and manager, developing residential communities such as Yas Island, Saadiyat Island and Al Raha, and owning retail, hospitality and education assets, plus an international arm through Aldar Investment and acquisitions such as SODIC in Egypt. Customers are home buyers, tenants and institutions. Listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ALDAR), with major shareholders including Alpha Dhabi. Well known in the UAE and a regional sponsor and partner in sport and leisure.

Alexandria Real Estate Equities is a Pasadena, California REIT focused on life science real estate, owning laboratory and office campuses in clusters such as Cambridge, San Francisco, San Diego and Seattle, leased to biotech, pharma and research institutions. It earns rent and calls itself the first, longest-standing life science REIT. Listed on the NYSE (ARE). B2B landlord, low consumer awareness.

American Healthcare REIT is a real estate investment trust based in Irvine, California that owns and operates healthcare properties, mainly senior housing operating communities, skilled nursing and medical office buildings in the US, plus some in the UK. It formed in 2021 from the merger of Griffin-American Healthcare REIT III and IV and listed on the NYSE (AHR) in 2024. Revenue is rent and operating income. Investor-facing, with no consumer brand.

Arbor Realty Trust is a Uniondale, New York real estate finance company and REIT that originates and services multifamily and other commercial real estate loans, including bridge loans, agency loans through Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac and HUD, and manages a large servicing portfolio. Customers are property owners and developers. Listed on the NYSE (ABR). Financial B2B business with minimal consumer visibility.

Avis Budget Group is a Parsippany, New Jersey car rental group operating the Avis, Budget and Zipcar brands, plus Payless, Apex and others, serving leisure and business travellers at airports and city locations in about 180 countries via company-owned and licensee operations. Revenue comes from rentals and ancillary services, fleet around 700,000 vehicles. Listed on Nasdaq (CAR). Strong consumer brands, with past sports sponsorship experience.

Baker Hughes is a Houston-based energy technology company providing oilfield services and equipment, turbines, compressors, LNG technology and industrial and climate solutions to oil and gas, power and industrial customers in over 120 countries, with about 55,000 employees. Revenue is around $27 billion. It resulted from the 2017 combination of Baker Hughes and GE Oil & Gas, and is listed on Nasdaq (BKR). B2B brand, but it has previously sponsored motorsport and sports.

Blackstone is the world's largest alternative asset manager, based in New York, with over $1 trillion in assets under management across private equity, real estate, credit and hedge fund solutions, serving pensions, sovereign wealth funds and individuals. Revenue comes from management and performance fees. Founded 1985 by Stephen Schwarzman and Peter Peterson, listed on the NYSE (BX). Owns many portfolio companies with consumer brands, but the firm itself is investor-facing.

BXP, formerly Boston Properties, is the largest publicly traded developer and owner of Class A office properties in the US, with a portfolio concentrated in Boston, New York, San Francisco, Washington DC and Los Angeles, leased to corporate, tech and law tenants. Headquartered in Boston and listed on the NYSE (BXP). Revenue is rental income. Investor-oriented brand with low consumer visibility.

CareTrust REIT is a San Clemente, California real estate investment trust that owns and leases skilled nursing, seniors housing and healthcare properties, primarily to independent operators such as The Ensign Group, with a growing portfolio in the US and UK. Revenue is triple-net rent. Spun out of Ensign in 2014 and listed on the NYSE (CTRE). Investor-facing company with no consumer brand.

Carrier Global is a Palm Beach Gardens, Florida maker of heating, ventilation, air conditioning, refrigeration and fire and security systems, with brands including Carrier, Toshiba and Viessmann Climate Solutions, selling to homeowners, buildings and cold-chain customers worldwide with roughly 45,000 employees. Spun out of United Technologies in 2020 and listed on the NYSE (CARR). Revenue around $22 billion. Carrier brand is widely known, though sales run through dealers and contractors.

CBRE Group is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, based in Dallas, offering leasing, sales, property and facilities management, project management, valuation and investment management to occupiers and investors in over 100 countries with about 140,000 employees. Revenue is above $35 billion. Listed on the NYSE (CBRE) and a Fortune 500 company. B2B brand, well recognised by business audiences.

Celestica is a Toronto-based electronics manufacturing services company that designs, manufactures and supplies hardware for communications, cloud and AI data center customers (including hyperscalers), as well as aerospace and industrial clients, with plants in Asia, Mexico and Europe. Revenue passed $9 billion in 2024 driven by AI networking and servers. Listed on the NYSE and Toronto Stock Exchange (CLS). B2B contract manufacturer with little consumer awareness.

Cerebras Systems is a Sunnyvale, California AI chip and systems company, founded in 2016, known for its Wafer-Scale Engine, a very large processor, and the CS-series systems. It sells AI hardware and cloud inference services to enterprises, research labs, governments and sovereign AI customers, with partners such as G42. Crunchbase shows about $4.7 billion in total funding. Went through a long IPO process. B2B, with limited consumer brand awareness.

Cloudflare is a San Francisco-based web infrastructure and security company founded in 2009, providing a global network offering CDN, DDoS protection, zero trust security, DNS, serverless edge computing (Workers) and AI inference to millions of internet properties and enterprises. Revenue is above $1.5 billion from subscriptions. Listed on the NYSE (NET). B2B but well known in tech; it has previously sponsored sports, including a Formula 1 team technology partnership.

Corning is a materials science company in Corning, New York, founded 1851, making specialty glass (Gorilla Glass for smartphones), optical fiber and cable, ceramics and life science labware, supplying Apple, Samsung, telecom carriers and data center customers. Revenue is around $13-14 billion. Listed on the NYSE (GLW). Known for Gorilla Glass and Pyrex heritage, B2B largely, with decent technology brand awareness.

Crusoe is a Denver, Colorado AI infrastructure company that builds energy-aware AI data centers and offers GPU cloud services, originally focused on using stranded or flared natural gas for compute and now building large campuses such as Abilene, Texas for OpenAI and Oracle (Stargate). Customers are AI labs and enterprises. Crunchbase shows about $8.1 billion in total funding. Private, B2B, with growing profile in AI circles but low consumer awareness.

CTP is a Dutch-headquartered developer, owner and manager of logistics and industrial real estate, the largest listed in continental Europe, with a portfolio of tens of millions of square metres, especially in Czechia, Romania, Hungary, Slovakia and Germany. Tenants are retailers, manufacturers and logistics firms. Founded by Remon Vos in Czechia, listed on Euronext Amsterdam (CTPNV) since 2021. B2B landlord with limited consumer awareness.

DISH Network is a Colorado pay-TV and wireless company with DISH satellite TV, Sling TV streaming and Boost Mobile, founded by Charlie Ergen. Customers are US households and mobile subscribers. EchoStar and DISH completed their merger at the end of 2023, so DISH is now a subsidiary of EchoStar (SATS), based in Englewood. Revenue about $15 billion. Strong consumer brands with past sports sponsorship and broadcast rights history.

Eletrobras is Brazil's largest electricity generation and transmission company, operating hydro, nuclear (via Eletronuclear), wind and solar plants plus tens of thousands of kilometres of transmission lines. It was privatised in 2022 when the federal government reduced its stake, and is listed on the B3 exchange (ELET3, ELET6) and NYSE (EBR), headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. Sells power to distributors and large industry. B2B, though a well known name in Brazil.

Envision Group is a Shanghai-based energy technology company founded by Zhang Lei in 2007, with Envision Energy (wind turbines), Envision AESC (batteries, with Nissan as a customer), and green hydrogen and energy storage businesses, plus an AIoT platform. Customers include utilities, automakers and developers. Privately held. Envision has also been a title sponsor of the Envision Racing Formula E team. B2B, but with real exposure in motorsport.

EPR Properties is a Kansas City, Missouri REIT specialising in experiential real estate, owning entertainment properties such as movie theaters (AMC and Cinemark), eat-and-play venues (Topgolf), ski resorts, attractions and fitness facilities, leased long term on net-lease terms. Founded 1997, listed on the NYSE (EPR). Revenue is rent. Investor-facing company, though its tenants' consumer brands are very well known.

Equinix is a Redwood City, California digital infrastructure company operating over 250 International Business Exchange data centers across about 70 metros on six continents, offering colocation, interconnection and the Platform Equinix, serving cloud providers, networks and enterprises. Revenue is around $8.5 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (EQIX) and structured as a REIT. B2B brand, recognised in technology circles but limited consumer awareness.

Essential Properties Realty Trust is a Princeton, New Jersey net-lease REIT that acquires, owns and manages single-tenant properties leased to small and medium-sized businesses such as car washes, restaurants, early childhood education and medical services across the US. Listed on the NYSE (EPRT) since 2018. Revenue is rental income. Investor-facing with no consumer brand.

Extell Development Company is a New York real estate developer behind skyscrapers and condominiums such as Central Park Tower, One Manhattan Square and the Brooklyn Tower tower plans. Founded and led by Gary Barnett, it builds and sells luxury residential, hotel and commercial projects, mainly in Manhattan. Privately held. Crunchbase shows about $3 billion in funding. Known in New York property circles, low national consumer brand awareness.

Extra Space Storage is a Salt Lake City, Utah REIT operating one of the largest self-storage networks in the US, with 4,000+ stores under the Extra Space, Life Storage and Storage Express brands, and a third-party management business. Customers are consumers and small businesses renting storage units; revenue about $3.3 billion. Acquired Life Storage in 2023. Listed on the NYSE (EXR). Recognisable consumer-facing brand in the US.

Federal Realty Investment Trust is a Rockville, Maryland REIT that owns and operates high-quality shopping centers and mixed-use properties in major coastal US markets, such as Santana Row in San Jose and Pentagon Row. Tenants include grocers, restaurants and retailers. It has increased its dividend for over 55 years. Listed on the NYSE (FRT). Investor-facing; property names such as Santana Row have some local consumer recognition.

First Capital REIT is a Toronto-based real estate investment trust that owns and develops grocery-anchored neighbourhood shopping centers and mixed-use properties in Canada's largest urban centers, such as Toronto, Montreal, Calgary and Vancouver. Tenants include grocers, pharmacies and service retailers. Listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (FCR.UN). Investor-facing landlord with limited national consumer brand awareness.

FirstEnergy Transmission is a regulated electric transmission business of FirstEnergy Corp, based in Akron, Ohio, operating high-voltage lines across Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia, Maryland, New Jersey and neighbouring states, mostly through units such as ATSI, Trans-Allegheny Interstate Line and Mid-Atlantic Interstate Transmission. Revenue comes from regulated transmission rates. Part of a NYSE-listed parent (FE). B2B utility infrastructure, no consumer brand of its own.

GardaWorld is a Montreal-area (Saint-Laurent, Quebec) private security services group, founded by Stephan Crete, providing armoured cash transport, security guarding, cash management, crisis and risk consulting and protective services for governments and corporates in about 45 countries. It has roughly 130,000 employees and revenue above $9 billion. Taken private in 2020 and owned by Crete with Apax Partners. B2B, little consumer brand awareness.

Invitation Homes is a Dallas-based REIT and the largest owner of single-family rental homes in the US, with around 85,000 homes in markets such as Atlanta, Phoenix, South Florida and Southern California, leased to residents on typical one-year terms. Formed from Blackstone's purchase of homes after the financial crisis and listed on the NYSE (INVH) in 2017. Merged with Starwood Waypoint in 2017. Resident-facing brand with moderate consumer awareness.

Janus Living is a Denver, Colorado senior housing real estate investment company; the Crunchbase description presents it as a REIT-style owner of senior housing communities and Crunchbase shows about $2.9 billion in total funding. It likely derives revenue from leasing senior living communities to operators. Beyond this, its ownership and portfolio are not clear from the data available. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Kimco Realty is a Jericho, New York REIT that owns and operates open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers and mixed-use properties across the US, with tenants such as Whole Foods, TJX and Home Depot. Following the 2021 merger with Weingarten Realty it is among the largest owners of this type. Listed on the NYSE (KIM). Revenue is rent. Investor-facing landlord with little consumer brand awareness.

Lambda is a San Francisco GPU cloud and AI infrastructure company, founded in 2012, offering on-demand and reserved NVIDIA GPU clusters, workstations and servers to AI researchers, startups and enterprises, and building large AI factories, with Microsoft and Nvidia deals. Crunchbase shows about $6.1 billion in total funding. It has pursued an IPO. B2B tech brand, well known among AI developers and with little public consumer awareness.

Millrose Properties is a Miami, Florida real estate company spun off from Lennar in 2025 that acquires and develops land and finished homesites and sells or options them to homebuilders, chiefly Lennar. It is structured as a REIT and listed on the NYSE (MRP). Revenue comes from lot sales and option fees. Investor-facing business with little consumer brand awareness.

Newmark Group is a New York commercial real estate advisory firm offering leasing, capital markets, property and facilities management, valuation and consulting to institutional owners and corporate tenants worldwide. Spun out of BGC Partners in 2018 and led by Barry Gosin; listed on Nasdaq (NMRK). Revenue is above $2.5 billion. B2B brand, known in real estate, with little consumer awareness.

NEXTDC is an Australian data center operator headquartered in Brisbane, running the N-series and S-series facilities in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Canberra, Adelaide and Darwin, providing colocation, interconnection and AI-ready capacity to enterprises, cloud providers and government. Listed on the ASX (NXT). The company also owns the AXON connectivity ecosystem. B2B infrastructure with limited consumer brand awareness.

NNN REIT, formerly National Retail Properties, is an Orlando, Florida real estate investment trust that owns more than 3,500 single-tenant net-leased retail properties across the US, tenanted by convenience stores, restaurants, auto service and other chains. Revenue is rent and it is known for decades of consecutive dividend increases. Listed on the NYSE (NNN). Investor-facing; no consumer brand.

Quanta Services is a Houston-based specialty contractor that designs, builds and maintains electric power transmission and distribution lines, substations, renewable generation, pipelines and communications infrastructure in North America and Australia, employing over 50,000 people. Customers are utilities, pipeline operators and telecoms. Revenue is around $24 billion. Listed on the NYSE (PWR). B2B, with limited consumer visibility.

Ras Laffan Petrochemicals is a joint venture in Qatar, owned by QatarEnergy, Chevron Phillips Chemical and others (QatarEnergy holds the majority), developing a world-scale ethane cracker and polyethylene complex at Ras Laffan Industrial City, near Doha. It is aimed at producing polyethylene for global export. Crunchbase shows about $4.4 billion in funding. State-linked, B2B industrial project with no consumer brand.

RioCan Real Estate Investment Trust is a Toronto-based Canadian REIT owning shopping centers and mixed-use properties in major urban markets, anchored by tenants such as Loblaw, Walmart, Canadian Tire and Cineplex, plus residential developments such as the Well. One of the country's largest REITs, listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (REI.UN). Revenue is rent. Investor-facing with local consumer recognition of its centers.

Safehold is a New York REIT that owns ground leases, long-term leases on the land underneath commercial and multifamily buildings, giving property owners a way to unlock value from land. Managed under the iStar and Safehold heritage and now an independent listed company on the NYSE (SAFE), with a ground lease portfolio valued at around $7 billion. Investor-facing, no consumer brand.

Saudi Real Estate Refinance Company (SRC) is a Riyadh-based government-backed mortgage refinancing company, owned by the Public Investment Fund, that provides long-term financing to banks and finance companies to support home ownership in Saudi Arabia under the Vision 2030 housing program. Revenue comes from refinancing lending and securitisation. Crunchbase shows about $7.3 billion in funding. State-linked B2B financier, with little direct consumer brand awareness.

Shapoorji Pallonji Group is a Mumbai-headquartered Indian conglomerate, over 150 years old, with businesses in construction and engineering (Shapoorji Pallonji & Co.), real estate, infrastructure, water, energy, shipping, textiles, and finance, plus a major stake in Tata Sons (about 18%). It is controlled by the Mistry family. Customers are governments, corporates and home buyers. Privately held. Well known in India's business and construction sector, but mostly B2B.

Simon Property Group is an Indianapolis-based REIT and the largest US mall operator, owning premium malls and outlets such as Roosevelt Field, King of Prussia and Premium Outlets, with international interests in Asia and Europe. Tenants are major retailers; revenue is above $6 billion in rent. Listed on the NYSE (SPG). Its malls are visited by tens of millions of shoppers, giving real consumer reach.

Snowflake is a San Mateo, California cloud data platform founded in 2012 that lets enterprises store, analyse and share data and build AI applications across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, sold on consumption pricing to thousands of customers including many Fortune 500 firms. Revenue exceeds $3.5 billion. Listed on the NYSE (SNOW) after a 2020 IPO. B2B tech brand, known among data teams; also an active sports sponsor, including with Formula 1 teams.

Somnigroup International is the Lexington, Kentucky mattress and bedding company formed when Tempur Sealy acquired Mattress Firm in 2025 and renamed itself. It makes and sells Tempur-Pedic, Sealy and Stearns & Foster mattresses and operates thousands of Mattress Firm retail stores in the US plus international markets, with revenue above $7 billion. Listed on the NYSE (SGI). Strong consumer brands; Tempur has long used sports and celebrity marketing.

Sunnova is a Houston-based residential solar and energy storage service provider that sold solar systems and batteries to US homeowners through leases, power purchase agreements and loans, via a network of dealers. It was listed on the NYSE (NOVA) but filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in June 2025 and is being restructured and sold. Revenue was around $700 million. A consumer-facing energy brand, though financially distressed.

TeraWulf is an Easton, Maryland digital infrastructure company that began as a bitcoin miner powered by nuclear and hydro energy and is converting its sites, such as Lake Mariner in New York, into high-performance computing and AI data center capacity leased to companies such as Fluidstack, backed by Google. Listed on Nasdaq (WULF). Crunchbase shows about $7.3 billion in funding. Investor-facing B2B brand, little consumer awareness.

The Boring Company is an Elon Musk-founded tunneling company based in Bastrop, Texas, building underground transport tunnels, including the Las Vegas Convention Center Loop that carries passengers in Tesla vehicles, plus other loop proposals. Customers are city and venue authorities, with revenue from construction contracts and rides. Spun out of SpaceX in 2016. Crunchbase shows funding of about $3.9 billion in total. Privately held, with strong media visibility via Musk.

Vanke (China Vanke) is a Shenzhen-based property developer, one of China's largest, building residential communities and commercial, logistics and rental housing across Chinese cities, and a service business (Wanwu). Listed in Shenzhen (000002) and Hong Kong (2202); Shenzhen Metro became its largest shareholder, and it has faced debt stress since 2021 along with the property downturn. Revenue was tens of billions of dollars. Known consumer brand in China's housing market.

VARO Energy (shown as VAROPreem) is a Cham, Switzerland energy company specialising in refining conventional fuels and marketing them, per Crunchbase, with about $3.3 billion in funding shown. VARO Energy is a energy group originally formed by Vitol and Carlyle, with refining, storage, retail fuels and bioenergy in Europe. Privately held, mostly B2B, with limited consumer visibility. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Vonovia is Germany's largest residential landlord, based in Bochum, owning and managing over 500,000 apartments in Germany, Sweden and Austria, and offering related services such as energy supply and maintenance. Tenants are private households; revenue is rent. Formed through the 2015 merger with Deutsche Annington and Gagfah. Listed in Frankfurt (VNA) and a DAX member. A large and well-known name in German housing, but not a consumer product brand.

W. P. Carey is a New York net-lease REIT, founded in 1973, that owns a diversified portfolio of industrial, warehouse, retail and office properties leased to corporate tenants in North America and Europe under long-term leases, plus an investment management business. Listed on the NYSE (WPC). Revenue is rent and fees. Investor-facing brand with no consumer awareness.

WSP Global is a Montreal-headquartered engineering and professional services firm (Quebec, despite the Ontario label in the data), providing design, advisory and project management for transportation, buildings, water, power, energy and environment in about 50 countries with over 70,000 employees. Revenue is around C$15 billion, and it acquired Golder, Wood's environment unit and others. Listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (WSP). B2B, little consumer awareness.

Al Ahli Bank of Kuwait (ABK) is a Kuwait City commercial bank providing retail, corporate, private banking and Islamic-style financial services to customers in Kuwait, with branches and subsidiaries in places such as Egypt, Qatar and the UAE, and a Lebanese presence. Founded in 1967 and listed on Boursa Kuwait (ABK). Crunchbase shows about $1.9 billion in funding. Recognised consumer bank in Kuwait; sponsor of sports and events regionally.

Avangrid Renewables is the renewable energy development and operations arm of Avangrid, based in Portland, Oregon, owning and operating wind, solar and storage projects across the US and selling power to utilities and corporate buyers. Avangrid is owned by Iberdrola, which took the company private in December 2024 (Avangrid was formerly on the NYSE as AGR). B2B energy producer, with little consumer brand visibility.

BADEA is the Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa, an intergovernmental development finance institution headquartered in Khartoum, Sudan, owned by Arab League member states, which finances development projects across sub-Saharan Africa and fosters Arab-African cooperation. Funding from the Crunchbase data is about $1.8 billion. Governmental, B2B institution with minimal consumer brand awareness.

Banca Transilvania is Romania's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Cluj-Napoca, providing retail, SME and corporate banking, cards, digital banking (BT Pay), leasing, asset management and insurance, with a network of branches and millions of customers, helped by its 2015 takeover of Volksbank Romania and the 2022 acquisition of OTP Bank Romania. Listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange (TLV). Strong consumer brand in Romania and a visible sponsor of sports and cultural events there.

Banco do Brasil is Brazil's largest bank by assets, majority state-owned by the federal government, headquartered in Brasilia, with retail, corporate, agribusiness and investment banking, and tens of millions of customers through thousands of branches. Founded in 1808, it is listed on the B3 exchange (BBAS3). One of the best-known consumer brands in Brazil and a long-time major sponsor of sport, notably volleyball and football.

Bladex (Banco Latinoamericano de Comercio Exterior) is a Panama City, Panama multinational bank founded in 1978 that provides trade finance and corporate loans to banks and companies across Latin America. Shareholders include central banks and state institutions, and it is listed on the NYSE (BLX). Customers are financial institutions and corporates. Crunchbase shows about $2.1 billion in funding. B2B bank, little public consumer awareness.

CAF (Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean, formerly Corporacion Andina de Fomento) is a multilateral development bank headquartered in Caracas, Venezuela, owned by Latin American, Caribbean and some European and Spanish member countries, providing loans, guarantees and technical assistance to governments and companies for infrastructure, climate and social projects. Crunchbase shows about $2 billion in funding. B2B institution, minimal consumer brand awareness.

Cemig (Companhia Energetica de Minas Gerais) is a Brazilian electric utility based in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, operating generation, transmission and distribution, and serving millions of customers through its distribution unit. The state of Minas Gerais is the controlling shareholder. Listed on B3 (CMIG4) and the NYSE. Strong regional brand in Minas Gerais, and active in sponsorship of local sports and culture.

Chariot Reinsurance is a Bermuda-based reinsurance company, formed in 2020 as a sidecar reinsurer backed by Chubb's Bermuda operations and investor capital, to take a share of Chubb's insurance risks. Crunchbase shows about $1.7 billion in funding and an asset management and financial services focus. Little additional detail is known. B2B financial vehicle with no consumer brand. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (MBK), serving about 5-6 million customers. Digital-first consumer bank, a well-known name in Poland and a visible sponsor of esports, football and cultural events.

Morgan Motor Company is a British sports car maker founded in 1909 by H.F.S. Morgan and based in Malvern Link, Worcestershire, hand-building cars such as the Plus Four, Plus Six, Super 3 and the Plus Six with ash-framed bodies. Owned by the Italian Investindustrial group since 2019. Production is a few hundred cars a year. Highly recognised heritage British brand with a premium, enthusiast following.

REEF Technology is a Miami-based company, formed in 2017, that converts urban parking lots into neighbourhood hubs for delivery kitchens, mobility, retail and logistics, partnered with Wendy's and Chick-fil-A for delivery kitchens. It was backed by SoftBank, Mubadala and Ares. Crunchbase shows about $1.5 billion in funding. It scaled back its kitchens in 2023-2024 and its parking operations were separated from the company. B2B real estate-tech with low consumer awareness.

Rivers Casino is a Pittsburgh-based casino and gaming brand operated by Rush Street Gaming (Rush Street Interactive), with properties in Pittsburgh, Philadelphia, Des Plaines in Illinois, Schenectady in New York, Portsmouth in Virginia, and an online sportsbook and casino (BetRivers). Customers are casino and online gamers. Crunchbase shows about $1.2 billion in funding. Strong regional consumer brand and a sports betting sponsor.

Samsung Life Insurance is Korea's largest life insurer, headquartered in Seoul, offering life, annuity and health insurance to millions of customers, and holds a major stake in Samsung Electronics. Part of the Samsung Group, founded in 1957 and listed on the Korea Exchange (032830). Assets are hundreds of billions of dollars. Highly recognised financial brand in Korea, including sports sponsorships.

ServiceTitan is a Glendale, California software company, founded in 2007, that offers cloud-based field service management, scheduling, payments and marketing tools for home service contractors such as plumbers, HVAC and electricians. It listed on Nasdaq (TTAN) in December 2024. Customers are tradespeople and contractors in the US and Canada. B2B software brand, well known in the trades.

Sohar International is an Omani bank, formed from the 2020 merger of Sohar Bank and HSBC Oman, headquartered in Muscat, offering personal, business and Islamic banking with an extensive branch network. Listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange (BKSB). Crunchbase shows about OMR 505 million in funding. Known consumer bank in Oman and a local sponsor of sports and cultural events.

SSG.COM is a Seoul-based Korean online retail platform of Shinsegae Group, selling goods from E-Mart, Shinsegae Department Store and others, including grocery delivery. Shinsegae's e-commerce arm, and it also acquired eBay Korea (Gmarket) in a 2021 deal with Alibaba. Customers are Korean consumers. Crunchbase shows about KRW 1.3 trillion in funding. Strong consumer brand in Korea.

Standard Bank Group is Africa's largest bank by assets, headquartered in Johannesburg, with retail, business and corporate banking in South Africa and about 20 countries across Africa, and a Chinese ICBC stake historically. Founded in 1862 and listed on the JSE (SBK). Millions of customers. Highly recognised financial brand across Africa, a sponsor of sport, music and the arts.

STO Express is a Shanghai-based Chinese express parcel delivery company, one of the big carriers in China's courier industry alongside ZTO and YTO, delivering billions of parcels annually through a franchise network. Listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (002468). Customers are e-commerce merchants and consumers. Crunchbase shows about $1.18 billion in funding. B2B logistics service, but a visible consumer logistics brand in China.

SWI Digital is a Houston-based digital infrastructure company in the bitcoin and blockchain categories, with about $1.6 billion in funding shown by Crunchbase. Its operations, hosting or mining scale, and ownership are not clear from the input. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

TEKEVER is a Lisbon-based Portuguese autonomous drone and AI company, founded in 2001, making maritime surveillance drones such as the AR3 and AR5, and satellite and AI software for governments and security forces. It became a unicorn in 2023 and its drones are used in Ukraine and by European agencies including Frontex. Customers are defence and civil authorities. B2B with growing public profile.

THG Ingenuity is the technology and e-commerce services division of THG (The Hut Group), Manchester, offering a platform and fulfilment for brands to sell direct to consumers worldwide, with clients including Nestle and Mondelez, and also operating the Ingenuity Commerce business. THG is listed on the London Stock Exchange (THG) and led by Matthew Moulding. Crunchbase shows about $1.6 billion in funding. B2B arm of a consumer group with brands like Myprotein.

Tongfu Microelectronics (TFME) is a Nantong, Jiangsu Chinese semiconductor packaging and testing company, among the world's top outsourced packaging firms, with customers including AMD, which holds a stake in its Suzhou and Penang operations. Listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (002156). Crunchbase shows about CNY 9.1 billion in funding. B2B chip service provider, no consumer brand.

Marelli is an automotive components supplier formed in 2019 by the merger of Magneti Marelli and Calsonic Kansei, headquartered in Saitama, Japan, making lighting, electronics, powertrain, thermal and interior parts for automakers. Owned by KKR. It filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the US in June 2025. Revenue was around 10 billion dollars. B2B, with heritage in motorsport through Magneti Marelli electronics.

Activision Blizzard was a Santa Monica, California video game company behind Call of Duty, World of Warcraft, Candy Crush (King) and Overwatch, with revenue of about 8 billion dollars. Microsoft completed its acquisition for about 69 billion dollars in October 2023, and it now operates within Microsoft Gaming and no longer reports separately. Hugely recognised consumer gaming franchises, with esports sponsorship experience.

Arctic Wolf is a Eden Prairie, Minnesota cybersecurity company, founded in 2012, offering a security operations platform with managed detection and response, monitoring and incident response, serving thousands of customers worldwide. It has raised about $900 million and acquired Cylance's assets. Privately held, B2B and well known among IT security buyers, and an active sponsor of motorsport and sport.

Boomi is a Conshohocken, Pennsylvania integration and automation software company, a pioneer in cloud iPaaS, serving thousands of customers with data integration, API management and AI agent tools. Created by Dell, then spun out to Francisco Partners and TPG in 2021. Crunchbase shows about $980 million in funding. B2B software known among IT teams, with some sports sponsorships.

CanSemi (Guangzhou CanSemi Technology) is a Guangzhou, China semiconductor company, one of the country's first specialised 12-inch analog chip foundries, manufacturing power management, analog and microprocessor chips for automotive and industrial clients. Crunchbase shows about $981 million in funding. B2B chip maker with limited consumer awareness.

Converge Technology Solutions is a Canadian IT solutions provider headquartered in Toronto (shown in Gatineau, Quebec), offering cloud, AI, cybersecurity and managed services through acquired IT firms across North America and the UK. H.I.G. Capital acquired it in 2025 in a take-private deal, with the shares formerly on the TSX (CTS). Customers are mid- to large enterprises. B2B IT reseller with low consumer awareness.

Edenor is Argentina's largest electricity distribution company, supplying the northern part of Greater Buenos Aires and part of the capital to about three million customers. Listed on the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange and the NYSE (EDN). Controlled by Edison Holding. Regulated utility revenue. Well-known local utility name with limited sponsorship profile.

Everstream is a Cleveland, Ohio fiber network and telecom provider, offering dark fiber, wavelengths, internet and cloud connectivity to businesses, carriers and data centers across the Midwest and Northeast. Owned by funds including Goldman Sachs. Everstream filed for Chapter 11 in 2025 with assets to be sold to lenders. Crunchbase shows about $900 million in funding. B2B telecom with low consumer awareness.

Five Holdings is a Dubai-based real estate and hospitality investment firm, owner of FIVE Hotels and Resorts brands including FIVE Palm Jumeirah, FIVE Jumeirah Village and Zurich properties, with a boutique lifestyle focus. Crunchbase shows about $1 billion in funding. Consumer-facing hospitality brand with a strong nightlife and event profile in Dubai.

Globeleq is a Cape Town-based independent power producer developing, building and operating power plants across Africa and Latin America, with solar, wind, gas and hydro assets in Kenya, Tanzania, Egypt, South Africa and Honduras. Majority owned by British International Investment and Norfund (Norway). Customers are state utilities. Crunchbase shows about $940 million in funding. B2B power producer, low consumer visibility.

Hive Box (China Hive Box) is a Shenzhen-based operator of smart self-service parcel lockers across China, with hundreds of thousands of cabinets in residential communities and campuses. Founded in 2012, it earns fees from couriers and advertising, and is backed by SF Express, Alibaba and others. Crunchbase shows about $1.09 billion in funding. Visible street-level brand in China, mostly B2B revenue.

Huitongda is a Nanjing-based Chinese company, a rural e-commerce and logistics service network backed by Alibaba and Suning, supplying home appliances and goods to county and village stores. It listed in Hong Kong (9878) in 2022. Crunchbase shows about CNY 6.3 billion in funding. B2B2C platform with limited consumer awareness in cities.

Kuwait International Bank (KIB) is a Kuwaiti Islamic bank, headquartered in Kuwait City, offering Sharia-compliant retail, corporate and investment banking services. Founded as a conventional bank and converted to Islamic principles, it is listed on Boursa Kuwait (KIB). Crunchbase shows about $1.1 billion in funding. Established regional consumer bank with local sponsorship activity.

LeapFrog Investments is a Johannesburg- and Mauritius-linked impact investor in financial services and healthcare for emerging markets, with about $1 billion of capital invested into insurers and fintechs across Africa and Asia, such as Resolution Insurance and Indonesia's. Customers are portfolio companies and investors. Private equity firm with strong ESG branding but low consumer awareness.

Lionheart Studio is a South Korean game developer in Seongnam, Gyeonggi, maker of mobile and online games, and as per Crunchbase has raised about $924 million. Crunchbase's funding figure looks large for the profile, so the entity should be verified. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Maybank (Malayan Banking Berhad) is Malaysia's largest bank, headquartered in Kuala Lumpur, providing retail, commercial, investment and Islamic banking, insurance and asset management in Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia and other ASEAN markets, serving about 22 million customers. Founded 1960, listed on Bursa Malaysia (MAYBANK). Major consumer brand across ASEAN with extensive sports and cultural sponsorship, including football and golf.

Mollie is an Amsterdam-based European payments company, founded in 2004, providing online payment processing, checkout and merchant banking for hundreds of thousands of small and medium businesses across Europe. Backed by General Atlantic and Technology Crossover Ventures, and valued at about 6 billion dollars in 2021. Crunchbase shows about $928 million in funding. B2B fintech with growing European brand recognition.

OTE (Hellenic Telecommunications Organization) is Greece's largest telecom group, headquartered in Athens, operating the Cosmote mobile brand and fixed-line and broadband services plus TV (Cosmote TV, sports rights). Deutsche Telekom controls the majority. Listed on the Athens Stock Exchange (HTO). Millions of customers. Very strong consumer brand in Greece, and a major sports sponsor including for Greek football and basketball.

OVHcloud is a French cloud computing provider, founded in 1999 in Roubaix by Octave Klaba, offering servers, hosting, private and public cloud and domain services from its own data centers across Europe and elsewhere, and promoting data sovereignty. It listed on Euronext Paris (OVH) in 2021. Customers are developers and enterprises. B2B cloud brand with moderate European awareness.

Pampa Energia is an Argentine integrated energy company, headquartered in Buenos Aires, with power generation (thermal, hydro, wind), oil and gas production including shale in Vaca Muerta, petrochemicals and a stake in the Transener grid. Listed on the Buenos Aires exchange and the NYSE (PAM). Customers are power buyers, industry and oil refiners. B2B energy group, notable in Argentine business.

Pluspetrol is an Argentine oil and gas exploration and production company, headquartered in Buenos Aires, founded in 1976, operating in Argentina (including Vaca Muerta), Peru (Camisea gas), Colombia and Bolivia. It also acquired ExxonMobil's Argentine upstream assets. Privately held. Crunchbase shows about $975 million in funding. B2B upstream company with no consumer brand.

project44 is a Chicago-based supply chain visibility platform, founded in 2014, which tracks shipments across road, rail, ocean and air for shippers, carriers and logistics providers, using real-time data networks. It raised about $940 million, at a valuation of over 2 billion dollars. Customers are large enterprises. B2B software with moderate visibility in logistics and sports sponsorship interest.

Rezolv Energy is a Prague-headquartered developer, owner and operator of renewable power projects in Central and Eastern Europe, such as wind and solar in Poland, Romania, Bulgaria and the Baltics, backed by institutional investors. Crunchbase shows about $1.09 billion in funding. B2B renewable developer, relatively young, with no consumer brand. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

San Matias Pipeline is a special-purpose vehicle in Argentina developing a gas pipeline for exports from Vaca Muerta, part of the Argentina LNG related infrastructure. Crunchbase shows about $900 million in funding. B2B project company with no consumer brand, based in Buenos Aires. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Securonix is a Plano, Texas cybersecurity analytics company that provides a cloud-native security information and event management platform, using behaviour analytics and AI to detect threats for large enterprises. Founded in 2008. Crunchbase shows about $1.06 billion in funding. B2B security software, known to security teams.

Shanghai ANE Logistics is a Shanghai-based Chinese less-than-truckload and express logistics company, operating a network of transport lines and delivery points for cargo shipping. Crunchbase shows about $970 million in funding. B2B freight services with limited public brand beyond China's logistics industry. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Uber Freight is Uber's logistics arm, headquartered in San Francisco, operating a digital freight marketplace and brokerage that connects shippers with truck drivers and carriers, plus transportation management software and managed logistics. It spun from Uber's 2017 launch and revenue is over 5 billion dollars. Crunchbase shows about $1.05 billion in funding. B2B brand from a famous parent consumer company.

Yunwang Wandian is a Shenzhen-based Chinese retail e-commerce company, per Crunchbase, with about CNY 6 billion in funding. It is understood to offer an online retail platform for small stores, but details and ownership should be checked. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Zhuanzhuan is a Beijing-based Chinese second-hand goods marketplace backed by 58.com and Tencent, where users trade used phones, electronics and fashion, with inspection and warranty services. It became part of the 58 Group family and spun out as a separate entity. Crunchbase shows about $990 million in funding. A well known consumer app in China's resale market.

Ajman Bank is an Islamic commercial bank in the emirate of Ajman, UAE, offering retail, business and treasury services under Sharia rules. Founded in 2008 and listed on the Dubai Financial Market (AJMANBANK). Crunchbase shows about $800 million in funding. Regional consumer bank, with sponsorship of local events.

Alkami Technology is a Plano, Texas cloud-based digital banking platform company, founded in 2009, providing online and mobile banking, onboarding and fraud tools to banks and credit unions in the US. Listed on Nasdaq (ALKT) since 2021. Customers are around 300 financial institutions. B2B software, with end-customer brand hidden behind clients.

Ameresco is a Framingham, Massachusetts energy efficiency and renewable energy services company, designing and building energy savings projects, solar, storage and renewable natural gas for governments, universities and businesses in the US, Canada and UK. Founded in 2000 by George Sakellaris. Listed on the NYSE (AMRC). Revenue is around 1.7 billion dollars. B2B with modest brand awareness.

Ampla is a New York fintech offering tech-enabled financing to help e-commerce and consumer brands with working capital, formerly Payability. Crunchbase shows about $840 million in funding, including debt facilities. Customers are online merchants. B2B fintech with niche awareness among sellers.

Ampol is an Australian fuel supplier and convenience retailer headquartered in Sydney (Alexandria), formerly Caltex Australia, running the Lytton refinery in Queensland, a network of petrol stations, and acquiring EG Australia's retail sites in 2025. Listed on the ASX (ALD). Revenue is about 30 billion Australian dollars. Strong consumer brand in Australia and a long-standing sponsor of motorsport and sports.

AmWINS Group is a Charlotte, North Carolina wholesale insurance distributor, offering specialty property, casualty and employee benefits placement, through a large network of brokers, to retail agents. Founded in 2002 and privately held; Crunchbase shows about $873 million in funding. B2B intermediary, known in the insurance industry.

Antora Energy is a San Jose, California thermal battery company, founded in 2017, whose carbon-based Thermal Battery stores electricity as heat for industrial processes. It has raised close to $770 million, including from Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Shell Ventures, and has a manufacturing site in Sunnyvale. Customers are heavy industrial firms. B2B cleantech with growing profile.

Apex is a Los Angeles space manufacturing company, founded in 2022, producing standardised satellite buses at scale in a factory in Los Angeles, with customers including government and commercial satellite operators. It has raised about $722 million. B2B space hardware maker with growing profile among defence and tech investors.
